scenarios.name: test-owned
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage AbilityOwnershipTest#testOwned. 3 XMage trigger-order choice(s) dropped (gorge keeps the offered order). 1 XMage choice(s) gorge never asks were dropped.
scenarios.known_bug: B6: ChangeZoneAll GainControl$ moves the card under its OWNER and emits ControlChange only after the battlefield MoveZone (effects/zone_changeall.go:248 then :271; same order in effects/zone_change.go:1481), so Soul Snuffers' ETB trigger is controlled by its owner and Obelisk Spider ("you put") never triggers. CR 110.2a, 603.3a.
